summary: - **[key4hep/EDM4hep#528](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/528)** — Adds a `timeError` member to `TrackerHit3D`, `TrackerHitPlane`, `SenseWireHit` and the `TrackerHit` interface. This bumps the schema version, and the previous schema is kept as `old_schemas/edm4hep_v6.yaml` for schema evolution. Producers and consumers of tracker hits can now carry per-hit timing uncertainties.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#124](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/124)** — Fixes the hit covariance orientation in `prepareTrackerHits`. The `du`/`dv` uncertainties are now rotated from the hit's own axes into the ACTS surface frame instead of being assigned directly to loc0/loc1. In endcaps where the axes were swapped, good hits previously failed the CKF χ² cut, which truncated or lost forward tracks. Barrel results are unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#125](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/125)** — Adds an `InitialTrackError_QOverP` property to `CKFTrackingAlg` and `GNNTrackFinder`. It is an absolute q/p error added in quadrature to the purely relative initial error. High-pT seeds can then have their momentum corrected by the CKF without letting soft seeds drift into fake high-pT tracks.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1690](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1690)** — DDG4 sensitive detectors now keep track-state changes (such as a volume exit) even when a low-energy step is removed by the energy filter. Previously such hits stayed open into the next sensor and were placed at an averaged position outside any sensor, for example as a spurious stripe at z=0 between endcaps.

- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#490](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/490)** — Fixes Marlin random seeds not being refreshed per event. A new `LCEvent` is often allocated at the same address as the previous one, so the pointer-based new-event check skipped the refresh and Marlin processors reused the same random sequence across events. A regression test is included.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#66](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/66)** — Fixes two bugs in `EDMToHepMCConverter`: particle energy was set to the mass, and vertex time was divided by c instead of multiplied. Fixes the time offset in `FlatSmearVertex` for events shifted along the beam axis.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#62](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/62)** — `HepMCToEDMConverter` now includes vertex time and preserves the HepMC particle order. ddsim hit outputs from HepMC3 and EDM4hep inputs now match.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#117](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/117)** — `VTXdigitizerDetailed` now reads sensor thickness from the sensitive volume rather than from the `ZPlanarData`/`ZPetalData` extensions. The detailed digitizer can therefore run on compound vertex detectors such as ALLEGRO's. CLD output is verified unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#112](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/112)** — The GenFit track fitter now resets the global TGeoManager navigator to a canonical state before each fit and restores it afterwards. Previously, the material found at geometry boundaries could depend on the previously fitted track, so fit results varied with processing order.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1699](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1699)** — The calorimeter barrel and endcap surface plugins now accept `symmetry=0` to create cylindrical surfaces instead of only polyhedral ones. This is needed to extrapolate tracks correctly to the ALLEGRO ECAL.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#403](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/403)** — Adds an option to run conformal tracking on silicon hits in the ALLEGRO digitisation and reconstruction sequence, enabled for the o1_v03 and o2_v01 tests. It relies on companion changes in k4Reco (keeping tracks without an ECAL intersection) and on cylindrical calorimeter surfaces.

- **[key4hep/k4PFHitML#5](https://github.com/key4hep/k4PFHitML/pull/5)** — Aligns the HitPF output definitions with Pandora by adding HitPF cluster outputs and updating the `referencePoint` definition. This makes the ML particle-flow outputs directly comparable with Pandora's.
